context.target_user: Local service marketers and SEO practitioners
context.problem: Discovering live consumer search questions and intent hierarchies.
context.use_case: Visual radial question mapping from Google PAA data.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 02, AlsoAsked mapped a 3-tier hierarchy of 38 live Google PAA questions. Listed as a specialized search intent research resource; does not provide keyword volume metrics.
when_to_consider: For deep People-Also-Ask visual query clustering during early topic discovery.
when_not_to_use: When search volume or competitive ranking metrics are required.
